references.text: Contrasts the fathers who died in the wilderness with the new generation that was to enter the land, a theme Jesus develops regarding dying or living.
The first time manna is given as food in the wilderness, confirming that the fathers ate it before they died.
The psalm tells the story of manna and emphasizes that the fathers ate it, but implies their death due to sin and lack of faith.
Refers to God's gift of manna to the fathers in the wilderness as evidence of His provision, even though they died.
Points to the same event in the wilderness and notes that those who ate manna died, serving as a warning against falling away.
